thread:
edr-bot: ALERT: EDR detected uncommon DLL injection and auto-run entry on DEV-PLAT-091 (owner: jay.choi). Quarantine applied at 2026-03-19T21:02:47Z.
maria: tagging @dan @ben for triage. Jay, can you confirm you still have the laptop and haven't restarted?
dan: I can see the agent heartbeat stopped network access at 21:03. Device flagged as "isolated". I'll remove corporate VPN certs and block outbound shortly.
jay.choi: yep i'm here, no reboot. I lost network right after a popup. didn't install anything knowingly.
maria: don't reboot or sign into other services from that device. we'll run triage remote-read-only first.
ben: prepping live-collect. need a support token and will grab process tree, loaded modules, and a RAM image.
it-ops-bot: Support ticket IT-4972 created, assignee: dan.
dan: got the token, starting support session. running remote ps and module dump.
ben: commands I'll run (minimal listing):
```
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process | Select Id,Name,Path,CommandLine" > procs.txt
Get-ItemProperty HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run > runkeys.txt
netstat -nab > netstat.out
C:\Tools\volatility -f memory.raw --profile=Win10x64 pslist > vol_ps.txt
certutil -hashfile C:\Temp\maldll.dll SHA256
```
maria: check for scheduled tasks, browser helper objects, and shell extensions. Also grab Sysmon logs and PowerShell transcript if enabled.
ben: found a dropped DLL in %TEMP% named zeta_loader.dll. SHA256: 8b1d3f9a2c4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0. Uploaded sample to \fileshare\triage\DEV-PLAT-091\samples\.
charlie: checking KMS logs for jay.choi service principal usage. so far no KMS decrypt API calls from his principal in the last 48h. setting an alert for rising activity.
cloud-sec: if there is any chance credentials were exposed, we'll rotate any keys tied to jay and reissue short-lived tokens. starting rotation for CI runner role used by his account.
maria: good. also perform RBAC audit for any recently elevated roles under jay. look for admin grants in past 7 days.
charlie: quick RBAC snapshot: jay has dev-role and temporary access to infra-role via approval flow 3 days ago. infra-role has ability to request KMS decrypt for certain resources. recommending immediate removal of temporary grant and review approval logs.
ben: YARA scan returned matches against a heuristic loader rule in the dropped DLL. Strings include `CreateRemoteThread` and `rundll32` command patterns.
forensics-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-193. Playbook: isolate -> collect -> static/binary analysis -> credential review -> containment actions.
maria: timeline: 21:02 detection, 21:03 isolation, 21:10 artifact collection started, 21:28 initial static analysis YARA positive.
dan: network flow shows no successful lateral connections from host to internal IPs. only outbound to three uncommon IPs which are currently blocked.
ben: memory image captured and hashes uploaded. mutex observed: Global\\ZetaInit_9f1c. IOC list being compiled.
maria: immediate actions checklist:
- rotate any machine-scoped creds and service tokens used by jay (cloud-sec).
- revoke temporary RBAC grants (charlie).
- add specific YARA rule to EDR and push detection signature (ben).
- schedule reimage if persistence confirmed (dan).
- preserve user's project files, pull from backup if reimage needed (it-helpdesk).
charlie: revoking temporary infra-role access now. documenting approval revocation in case audit needs it.
cloud-sec: rotated three service tokens and flagged the old keys as compromised. posting KMS rotation ticket KMS-762.
jay.choi: will my local SSH keys be affected? I use a personal key for some repos.
maria: personal keys on device won't be rotated automatically. if you used corporate credentials or had any CLI sessions open, assume those tokens compromised and reissue from new machine after cleanup.
ben: static analysis notes: loader drops secondary stage via base64-encoded PowerShell, writes to \AppData\Local\Temp, creates HKCU Run entry: `MyUpdater` -> `rundll32.exe "%TEMP%\\zeta_loader.dll",EntryPoint`.
dan: recommending reimage due to persistence in user profile run key plus encoded PowerShell child. will coordinate with Jay for device swap.
it-helpdesk: We can provision replacement within 24 hours. will schedule backup of user docs and a vetted restore image.
forensics-bot: Next steps assigned: ben (binary analysis + IOC feed), charlie (RBAC audit notes), cloud-sec (KMS rotations), dan (reimage coordination).
maria: please add any hashes, domains, mutex names to the incident ticket INC-2026-193. we'll run hunt queries across EDR for similar runkey patterns and process commandlines.
ben: uploading IOCs: hash above, domain `updates.zeta-service[.]com`, mutex `Global\\ZetaInit_9f1c`, command pattern `rundll32.exe "%TEMP%\\*.dll",*`.
charlie: pushed RBAC audit logs to the ticket, found one approval request that looks suspiciously automated; keeping that for further review.
cloud-sec: monitoring KMS logs in real-time and will alert if any decrypts occur using rotated keys.
jay.choi: thanks all. i'll hand over laptop and follow reimage instructions. please notify when it's safe to login again.
maria: we'll aim for all-clear or reimage recommendation by EOD. if anyone sees matching alerts on other hosts, escalate to #incidents.
edr-bot: Device DEV-PLAT-091 remains quarantined. Reminder: if reimaged, run offline full scan and submit all artifacts to the incident bundle.
